basic_profile.bio: I'm a 24-year-old college student living in Portland, Maine. I've recently developed an interest in cannabis culture and I'm exploring local dispensaries and caregiver options. In my free time, I enjoy watching car videos, especially about Lamborghinis, and I'm an active member of the misophonia support community, as I deal with the condition myself. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings after classes. Currently single and focused on my studies in Environmental Science, I work part-time at a local coffee shop.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My knowledge about cannabis is still budding; I'm learning through personal experience, recommendations from friends, and online research. My interest in cars comes from years of watching car reviews and following automotive news online.
